feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is the iteration 8 design (sensors at x = ±0.030 m, 16 mm footprints, kp 6.0, kd 0.6, ki 0.05, last_direction, score 123.04) with one change: base_speed 1.4 to 1.2. The single-variable isolation is sound. Iteration 0 to 1 showed that lowering speed from 1.8 to 1.4 raised progress on all three tracks (oval 0.12 to 0.21, s-bend 0.055 to 0.098), so the speed-to-progress direction has evidence behind it. Iteration 9 showed that widening the sensors to ±0.040 m and raising kp to 8.0 did not help (75.78, oval progress 0.30), so the candidate correctly returns to the iteration 8 geometry and gain instead of extending that line. Oval max_error has stayed at 0.061 to 0.065 across kp 6.0 to 8.0 and sensor reach ±0.030 to ±0.040 m (iterations 2 to 9), so body width and gain alone are not closing the 0.06 m off-track gap. The candidate's expected max_error improvement is a hypothesis to test, not a finding. Approve so it races: this is a clean, low-risk test from the best design, and with one iteration left after this one the race is the only source of new evidence.

After the race, use the telemetry as follows. If oval and s-bend progress both rise above the iteration 8 values (0.57 and 0.24) and max_error falls, keep base_speed 1.2 as the base for the final iteration. If progress falls on either track, return base_speed to 1.4 and keep the iteration 8 gains. If line_loss_events stay at 1 or more at the same bend entries, the next lever is line_loss search_left or search_right, favouring the side the failing bends turn towards, tested only after the speed result is known.
requested_changes: After the race: if oval and s-bend progress both rise above 0.57 and 0.24 (iteration 8), keep controller.base_speed at 1.2 and carry it forward as the base for the final iteration, because iteration 0 to 1 showed slower speed improved progress.

After the race: if progress falls on any track, return controller.base_speed to 1.4 with kp 6.0 and kd 0.6 (iteration 8), because iteration 9 showed that sensing reach and gain changes did not improve progress and iteration 8 is the best-supported configuration.

After the race: if line_loss_events stay at 1 or more at the same bend entries (iteration 8: 1.4 oval, 1.3 s-bend), change controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_left or search_right, favouring the side the failing bends turn towards, and keep the speed that gave the better progress.
